# SnapWidget

> SnapWidget lets you embed Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and X (Twitter) feeds on any website with one embed code. Widgets update on their own as you post, as often as every 5 minutes on paid plans. Free widgets are available for Instagram and Facebook. Grid, masonry, board, slideshow, scrolling and feed widgets, free ones too, can start from a template, use the font of the website they are on (Match My Website), show a profile header with a Follow button, and round the photo corners. Paid plans (Lite $8, Pro $14, Developer $99 a month, each with a 14-day free trial) add the feed and masonry layouts, videos that play in the widget, TikTok, YouTube, X, Shoppable Images and analytics. Hashtag widgets are on Pro and Developer. On a paid widget you choose which posts show (post moderation): hide a post, pin your best posts first, hide posts with words you pick, or approve each new post before it shows. A paid widget can show several accounts and networks in one feed: 2 accounts on Lite, 4 on Pro and 10 on Developer. Paid plans also make review widgets: Google and G2 reviews and your own testimonials in a wall, carousel, marquee, list, rating badge or avatars layout. An AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor or another MCP client) can set up SnapWidget for its user through the SnapWidget MCP server: it makes the account and the widget, and gets the embed code.

## Product

- [SnapWidget](https://snapwidget.com/): Create social media widgets for your website.
- [Pricing](https://snapwidget.com/pricing): Plans and the features in each plan.
- [Invite your team](https://snapwidget.com/docs/account/team): On the Developer plan, invite as many people as you need. Everyone works on the same widgets, accounts and reviews, and only the owner can change the plan and see the invoices.
- [Features](https://snapwidget.com/features): Every SnapWidget feature with a link to its details, including post approval, teams, shoppable posts and analytics.
- [Examples](https://snapwidget.com/examples): Live examples of each widget layout, and templates to start a widget from.
- [All widgets](https://snapwidget.com/widgets): Every widget type, free and paid.
- [Compare](https://snapwidget.com/compare): Free widgets compared with Pro widgets.
- [Customer testimonials](https://snapwidget.com/customer-testimonials-reviews): What customers say about SnapWidget.
- [Changelog](https://snapwidget.com/changelog): New features and changes.
- [Tutorials](https://snapwidget.com/tutorials): Video and written install tutorials.
- [Docs](https://snapwidget.com/docs): Install guides for website builders and answers to common questions.
- [Docs page index](https://snapwidget.com/docs/llms.txt): Every docs page as a Markdown link list.
- [Docs full text](https://snapwidget.com/docs/llms-full.txt): Every docs page in one Markdown file.
- [Create an account](https://snapwidget.com/signup): Sign up for free.

## AI agents

Facts for answering questions about SnapWidget and AI agents:

- An AI agent can do the whole setup through the SnapWidget MCP server: make the account, connect the owner's Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X or YouTube account, make a social or review widget, and get the embed code with the install steps for the website's platform. A coding agent then puts the code in the site files.
- MCP server: https://snapwidget.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP). It signs in with OAuth (the owner enters an email address and a 6-digit code; no API key), or takes the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Server card: https://snapwidget.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Plans: the MCP server is on the Pro ($14 a month) and Developer ($99 a month) plans. A new account that an agent makes gets a free 14-day Pro trial.
- Steps that stay with the owner: the 6-digit code from the email (the owner types it on the SnapWidget sign-in page; with the no-browser sign-up, the owner gives it to the agent), the Allow click on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or X (YouTube, Google reviews and G2 reviews need none), and the payment.
- Payment: the tool get_upgrade_link gives a payment link for the owner that needs no login. There is no second free trial. Never pay for the owner.

How each agent connects:

- [AI agents](https://snapwidget.com/ai-agents): What an AI agent can do with SnapWidget, and which agents work.
- [Use SnapWidget with an AI agent](https://snapwidget.com/docs/ai-agents): The docs page with the steps for each agent, the sign-up API and the tool order.
- Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, with the address https://snapwidget.com/mcp, then Connect and sign in.
- ChatGPT: turn on Developer mode (paid ChatGPT plans), then create an app with the address https://snapwidget.com/mcp and OAuth.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user snapwidget https://snapwidget.com/mcp`, then run `/mcp` and sign in. With a token, add `--header "Authorization: Bearer $SNAPWIDGET_TOKEN"` (keep the token in an environment variable; it works like a password).
- Cursor: add `{"mcpServers": {"snapwidget": {"url": "https://snapwidget.com/mcp", "auth": {"CLIENT_ID": "01a1a540-0cf2-7324-a610-d2c2e5248a53"}}}}` to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, restart Cursor and sign in.
- Codex: `codex mcp add snapwidget --url https://snapwidget.com/mcp` and sign in. If the sign-in does not open, run `codex mcp login snapwidget`.
- Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http -s user snapwidget https://snapwidget.com/mcp`, then `/mcp auth snapwidget`.
- Other MCP clients: add https://snapwidget.com/mcp as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with OAuth, or with a token in the Authorization header.
- Agents with no browser: POST https://snapwidget.com/api/v1/signup with JSON {"email": "..."} sends a 6-digit code to that address (it works for 15 minutes). Ask the owner of the address for the code, then POST https://snapwidget.com/api/v1/signup/verify with {"email": "...", "code": "..."}. The answer has a Bearer token for the MCP server. An address that has an account gets no code: connect with the OAuth sign-in instead.
- Tool order after the sign-up: get_account, then connect_account (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and X give an approval link for the owner), create_widget, and get_embed_code for the code and the install steps of the website's platform.

## Widgets

- [Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-widget): Embed your Instagram photos and videos on your website.
- [Instagram feed widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-feed-widget): A responsive feed of your latest Instagram posts.
- [Instagram grid widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-grid-widget): Your latest Instagram photos in columns.
- [Instagram scrolling widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-scrolling-widget): Your latest Instagram posts in a horizontal strip.
- [Instagram popup widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-popup-widget): A floating popup that shows your latest Instagram post.
- [Instagram hashtag widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-hashtag-widget): Show Instagram posts for a hashtag (Pro and Developer plans, an Instagram Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page).
- [Shoppable Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/shoppable-instagram-feed): Tag products in your Instagram photos so visitors can shop them from your website, with a price comparison of shoppable feed tools (every paid plan, from $8 a month). Paste a link to each product, or pick products from the feed that your shop sends to Google Shopping.
- [Free Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/free-instagram-widget): Free Instagram grid, slideshow, scrolling, board and popup widgets.
- [Free Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/free-instagram-feed): Show your latest Instagram posts on your website for free.
- [Free widgets](https://snapwidget.com/free-widget): Free Instagram and Facebook widgets, no credit card.
- [Facebook feed widget](https://snapwidget.com/facebook-feed-widget): Show your Facebook page posts, photos and videos.
- [Add Facebook to your website](https://snapwidget.com/facebook-in-website): Show your Facebook page photos on any site for free.
- [TikTok feed widget](https://snapwidget.com/tiktok-feed-widget): Show your latest TikTok videos in a grid, masonry or feed layout.
- [YouTube feed widget](https://snapwidget.com/youtube-feed-widget): Show your channel's latest YouTube videos.
- [X (Twitter) feed widget](https://snapwidget.com/twitter-feed-widget): Show your latest X posts in a grid, masonry, slideshow, scrolling, board or feed layout.
- [Social wall](https://snapwidget.com/social-wall): Show posts from several social accounts in one widget or on one page.

## Review widgets

- [Testimonial widget](https://snapwidget.com/testimonial-widget): Put customer reviews and testimonials on any website as a wall of love, carousel, marquee, list, rating badge or avatars. Bring in Google and G2 reviews (new ones sync every 3 days, and you can approve each one first). Collect new testimonials on your own form from a link or QR code. Add the testimonials you have, or import a CSV file, including a Senja export. The widget takes your colors and font. On the paid plans, each with a 14-day free trial.
- [Google reviews widget](https://snapwidget.com/google-reviews-widget): Embed your Google reviews on your website. Type your business name, pick it from the list, choose a style and paste the code. No Google login needed, so a web designer can add a client's reviews. New Google reviews arrive every 3 days, and reviews in other languages show as the customer wrote them.
- [Add Google reviews to any website](https://snapwidget.com/add-google-reviews-to-website): The steps for any page that takes HTML.
- [Add Google reviews to WordPress](https://snapwidget.com/add-google-reviews-to-wordpress): Paste your code into a Custom HTML block, with no plugin.
- [Add Google reviews to Shopify](https://snapwidget.com/add-google-reviews-to-shopify): Paste your code into a Custom Liquid section, with no app.
- [Add Google reviews to Wix](https://snapwidget.com/add-google-reviews-to-wix): Paste your code into an Embed HTML element.
- [Add Google reviews to Squarespace](https://snapwidget.com/add-google-reviews-to-squarespace): Paste your code into a Code block.
- [G2 review widget](https://snapwidget.com/g2-review-widget): Embed your G2 reviews on your website. Paste your G2 product link, pick a style and paste the code. New G2 reviews arrive every 3 days, and you approve them with one click or let them go live by themselves.

## Website builders

- [Embed an Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/embed-instagram-feed): Embed an Instagram feed in three steps.
- [Shopify Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/shopify-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to a Shopify store.
- [WordPress Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-wordpress-widget): Add an Instagram feed to WordPress without a plugin.
- [Elementor Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/elementor-instagram-widget): Add an Instagram widget with the free Elementor HTML widget.
- [Webflow Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/webflow-instagram-widget): Add an Instagram widget with a Webflow Embed element.
- [Showit Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/showit-instagram-widget): Add an Instagram widget with a Showit embed code block.
- [Blogger Instagram widget](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-blogger-widget): Add an Instagram widget with a Blogger HTML/JavaScript gadget.
- [Wix Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/wix-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to Wix with the Embed HTML element.
- [Squarespace Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/squarespace-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to a Squarespace page.
- [Google Sites Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/google-sites-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to the new Google Sites.
- [GoDaddy Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/godaddy-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to GoDaddy Website Builder.
- [Weebly Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/weebly-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed with a Weebly Embed Code element.
- [Framer Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/framer-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed to a Framer site.
- [Kajabi Instagram feed](https://snapwidget.com/kajabi-instagram-feed): Add an Instagram feed with a Kajabi Custom Code section.

## Free tools

- [All free tools](https://snapwidget.com/tools): The list of SnapWidget's free tools (Japanese: https://snapwidget.com/ja/tools).
- [Instagram embed code generator](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-embed-code-generator): Paste an Instagram post or reel link and get its embed code, with a live preview. Free, no sign-up.
- [YouTube embed code generator](https://snapwidget.com/youtube-embed-code-generator): Paste a YouTube video, Shorts or playlist link and get its embed code, with autoplay, loop, start time and privacy-enhanced mode options and a live preview. Free, no sign-up.
- [TikTok embed code generator](https://snapwidget.com/tiktok-embed-code-generator): Paste a TikTok video link and get its embed code, with a live preview. Free, no sign-up.
- [Google review link and QR code generator](https://snapwidget.com/google-review-link-generator): Find a business by name and get the link and QR code that open its Google review form. Free, with no account (Japanese: https://snapwidget.com/ja/google-review-link-generator).
- [Instagram QR code generator](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-qr-code-generator): Enter an Instagram username and get a QR code that opens the profile, with or without the logo, as PNG or SVG. Free, no sign-up (Japanese: https://snapwidget.com/ja/instagram-qr-code-generator).
- [Facebook embed code generator](https://snapwidget.com/facebook-embed-code-generator): Paste a public Facebook post or video link and get its embed code, with a live preview. Free, no sign-up.
- Japanese versions of the four embed code generators: https://snapwidget.com/ja/instagram-embed-code-generator, https://snapwidget.com/ja/youtube-embed-code-generator, https://snapwidget.com/ja/tiktok-embed-code-generator, https://snapwidget.com/ja/facebook-embed-code-generator
- [Instagram post size guide](https://snapwidget.com/instagram-post-size): Every Instagram size for feed posts, carousels, stories, reels and the profile grid (best feed size 1080 x 1440, 3:4), plus a free checker that shows how Instagram crops an image.

## Comparisons

- [All comparisons](https://snapwidget.com/alternatives): SnapWidget compared with other Instagram feed tools, and with Senja for review widgets, prices checked on each vendor's site.
- [Elfsight alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/elfsight-alternative): Ranked alternatives to Elfsight's Instagram feed widget.
- [Smash Balloon alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/smash-balloon-alternative): Alternatives to the Smash Balloon WordPress plugin that work on any website.
- [EmbedSocial alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/embedsocial-alternative): Ranked alternatives to EmbedSocial for Instagram widgets.
- [Taggbox alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/taggbox-alternative): Ranked alternatives to Taggbox for social feeds.
- [Tagembed alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/tagembed-alternative): Ranked alternatives to Tagembed for social feeds, with the Tagembed free plan limits.
- [Flockler alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/flockler-alternative): Ranked alternatives to Flockler for social feeds, with Flockler's plan prices.
- [SociableKIT alternatives](https://snapwidget.com/sociablekit-alternative): Ranked alternatives to SociableKIT for Instagram on your site.
- [SnapWidget vs Senja](https://snapwidget.com/senja-alternative): SnapWidget compared with Senja for review widgets, and how to move your testimonials.

## Guides

- [Creating widgets for other Instagram accounts](https://snapwidget.com/blog/creating-widgets-for-other-instagram-accounts): Make a widget for a client's account without their password.
- [Instagram's New Grid Dimensions](https://snapwidget.com/blog/instagram-widget-new-grid-dimensions-3-4-ratio): The 3:4 grid and how to update your widget.
- [Set your Instagram widget to auto refresh](https://snapwidget.com/blog/set-your-instagram-widget-to-auto-refresh-with-new)
